review_description: Quote was an easy experience. Installation went smoothly and according to plan!
Good customer service, tidy install, overall happy with the result
Very good service and communication. Quotation was great and the installation process also. I am confident the new battery will suit and support me from now on.

Adam and his Jet Solar team did a great job from start to finish. They communicated clearly with us upfront about our options and the costs. They then walked us through the process before installing our system, as well as recommendations for provider and all the details about our system to manage it accordingly. It was hassle free and couldn't be happier with the result.

Thank you Adam and Team from Jet Solar, such a pleasure to deal with a no nonsense company, no pressure just an all-round easy transaction, very neat and tidy team, everything was left spotless and unit looks amazing, thank you all once again for a great job!

Adam offered fantastic clear guidance on the most appropriate solar and battery system for my house. Communication across the board was prompt and easy. The installation from Paul, Cyrina and the team was completed to an exceptionally high standard, as remarked by the independent inspector post-install. I would not hesitate to use Jet Solar again into the future.

I engaged Jet Solar during the construction phase of a new home build to maximise the pre-wiring opportunities. Whilst this had advantages, it also caused some issues which they handled particularly well when dealing with our builder. They maintained contact throughout & kept me informed of changes in government legislation which affected my initial quotation. The installation work was done to a high quality & appointments were kept as planned to avoid disruption to my work commitments. Overall, I experienced excellent customer service and quality workmanship. Highly recommend.
Jet Solar did a fantastic job for us. The price was reasonable. Also they used good quality materials and products. They worked carefully and cleaned. No damage to roof and property. Thanks Jet Solar

Jet Solar replaced our old solar system with a newer system consisting of 11kw of panels and a 13kw Sungrow  battery. The process was very professional, Adam talked us through options and pricing and helped us decided on a good setup. Nothing was too much trouble, even when I changed my mind on the brand of battery at the last minute. The prices were very competitive  and much lower than some of the other quotes I had received.The install was done quickly and efficiently, Cyrina managed the install and her team well. The weather was not great, but they still got through the work in the 2 day timeframe.The battery was fully charged by lunchtime the first day and we have not used any power form the grid since. Even a recent full day of rain didn’t fully drain the battery.  It hasn’t been a full month yet, but I am looking forward to seeing the electricity bill for once.I would recommend Jet Solar to anyone looking to install or replace a solar system. They have been great to deal with and every person we have dealt with has been knowledgeable and professional. Thanks to the team for your great work.
Service was excellent. Additional attendances were prompt and informative. Electrical inspectors queries were handled quickly.

I recently had Jet Solar install a Sungrow solar & battery system and the whole experience was seamless from start to finish. Initial quoting with Adam was a great experience, he took time to explain the reason for the brand selection, the size of the package offered and how it aligned with my electricity needs. Acceptance and sign-up was unbelievably easy, Adam walked me through the sign-up over the phone including navigating all the websites to apply for the multiple rebates, state and federal. The pre-installation site visit from Scott was great, he took the time to discuss and explain the different options for placement of the inverter and battery, answering all my questions along the way.The team arrived on the agreed day and on time. What a great group of people. All of the team introduced themselves prior to starting work which added a personal touch to the installation. The weather was terrible on the day however they worked through the rain and strong winds completing the installation same day. Having their own team and not subcontracting out the work is clearly an advantage for Jet Solar. The team definitely enjoy what they do and take pride in their work. I could hear constant chatter and laughter through the day, which shows they have a strong bond with each other. The company also clearly cares about the safety of their workers. No corners were cut, as an example when the workers on on the roof installing the panels, they had erected roof barriers to prevent falls. Whilst this seems obvious, I have many trades on my roof in the past who have not taken this level of care and attention. The clean up after the job was spotless. No mess was left behind. I was then walked through the installation and set-up of the phone app and walked through the entire system operation prior to the team leaving the site.Overall an absolute wonderful experience from start to finish. No surprises along the way and the final result speaks for itself. If you’re considering solar, I highly recommend Jet Solar. Adam/Scott and their entire crew were an absolute delight to deal with and have provided a quality instal at a very competitive price.
They were great to work with. The price was good and the quality of work was great too.

I applied to have a Tesla Powerwall 3 and expanders installed through the Tesla website.  Jet Solar was chosen by Tesla, as Jet Solar are one of their Premium Installers, to contact me and provide a quote.  I already had a Tesla Gen 3 Wall Connector installed in my garage.  Adam from Jet Solar was very easy and friendly to deal with, and was very accommodating to changes that I requested (position of Powerwalls and solar panels).  The sparkies were all Jet Solar staff.  Very friendly, polite and professional.  Punctuality was spot-on; they were here ready to go exactly on time.  I'm a perfectionist, and their workmanship even impressed me beyond my expectations.  The solar panel arrays look exactly the same on both sides of my roof, and the Powerwall 3 and Expanders are perfectly installed (allowing for one more expander when my budget allows :-) ).  They even removed my broken roof tiles when they cleaned up, and they left all the areas where they worked cleaner and neater than when they started !!!  They walked me through the app connection and made sure I was happy with the Tesla app integration.  They even pre-booked the Electrical Safety Inspector ahead of time (he came the next morning after installation) so my system could be commissioned and fully integrated to the grid :-)10 / 10 !  Very highly recommended

Here I am, 2 years later after Jet Solar installed a 6kW upgrade to my existing system and a storage battery.....solar and battery system still going great guns, keeping the power bills low and keeping a few lights and fridges running when our unreliable local grid network often goes down.  Still only praise for Jet Solar.Now that the Energy Retailers have dropped the solar feed-in tariffs to essentially zero, but have hiked their prices over 40% in many cases over the last few years, I made the decision to add another 12.4kWh battery to my system.  I'm not going to pay back large rates for power I am essentially giving to the grid free of charge.Once again, Adam, Jason, Paul and the Team from Jet Solar did a great job....from the original quote to the final certification.  With no fuss, and no mess, they installed the extra battery promptly, seeing to all the details, even relocating the existing battery a little to ensure symmetry of the equipment when installing the additional battery - without needing to be asked.They are, and continue to be, a great company to work with!

From initial phone call through to follow up phone call, a seamless process. All correspondence was polite, knowledgeable and certainly not pressured. All my questions were answered and I felt very comfortable proceeding with Jet Solar. Site visits and installation appointments were punctual. All crew members were respectful and polite. Patience was shown when explaining app functioning. Thank you Jet Solar

We had a wonderful experience working with Jet Solar to get our solar panels and battery installed. They are very knowledgeable and answered all questions. They worked seamlessly to complete the job promptly. Highly recommend.

The installation process with Jet Solar was not without challenges, but overall, the result is very good.1. The team arrived on time.2. The site was kept clean, with all rubbish removed and even basic cleaning done afterwards.3. They reminded me about some existing issues with my house, which was helpful.4. After my initial solar install with Jet Solar back in early 2024, I recently had the team back to upgrade the system with a 30kWh Sungrow battery, 8 additional Jinko solar panels, and a new 15kW 3-phase inverter. The stuck to their booked site inspection and installation days.  The completed work was very tidy.  Everything has worked as it should.All round top marks.

Such a huge variance, and yet i couldn't find any justification for why they were worth more except "you get what you pay for" o.OOnce i whittled it down to about 5, it was time to start making some calls, and getting inspections. After some inspections, and some more follow up calls, it was clear Jet Solar was the installer to with. I called the other companies on the short list to thank them for their interest, and efforts, but that i was going with another installer. A few of the companies appreciated this courtesy, which in turn pleased me.Jet Solar in fact was the only installer who UNDER-sold me, as i originally thought of going for Sunpower's Maxeon panels, but it became apparent they simply were not worth the extra $10k compared to something like Jinko's Tiger Neo panels, or equivalent like Sunpower's own cheaper "Performance" panels.I could justify the extra outlay for micro-inverters over string inverters, but paying $10k on top of the $35k for just a "slightly better panel" that would barely show up in error margins for solar generation simply didn't make sense in the end.Adam at Jet Solar practically refused to let me buy the Maxeon's telling me "it's not worth it", because that for the extra 1% of efficiency they offer it's simply not worth paying an extra $10k when i have enough roof space to simply put a few more cheaper panels to make the difference in generation, then pocket the difference. Well, that sold me, i've never had a company undersell me before, so that told me Jet Solar were serious about prioritising customer satisfaction instead of "profits above all else".Jet Solar designed a beautiful panel layout, with tilted sections of the array on my roof spreading the generation throughout the day, instead of putting them all flat and simply concentrating the generation for a few peak hours around noon.  Titled panels mean they will "self drain" rainwater (and the dirt it carries, or "soiling") keeping them cleaner for longer, which in turn means i have to monkey my butt up there less to clean the array. Bloody marvelous.There was a 3 month lead-time, but it was worth the wait, and instal day came with a team of half a dozen knowledgeable, friendly, professional people all raring to go from the moment they stepped foot on my property at 7am. They all knew what they were doing, worked well together, and i was happy to keep them in tea, and coffee, to keep their flow going, it was the least i could do.They finished the entire hardware installation in a single day, impressive for a large array like this, with Scott coming back the next morning for a few hours to show me the ropes for the software, etc. Then just had to wait for the inspection guy to come a few days later to give it the regulatory thumbs-up, before we could switch the system on and start enjoying our new house toy.The whole system is very well balanced, with the tilted panels collecting energy almost as soon as sun breaks in the morning, right until sunset at night, the battery is doing a fine job filling night-duty, sometimes completely lasting until sun-up next morning. Although that's great for the current summer, winter will reveal the bottlenecks for sure, and hopefully by then Tesla will have "vehicle to home" charging so we can add the Tesla car's 80KW battery to the house, saving us the need to buy more Powerwalls :)Overall my wife, and I, are beyond impressed with Jet Solar, really the antithesis to the trope of the "tradie/cowboy" company you always dread having to deal with.This is the kind of company that strives hard for their customer, and i'm the kind of customer that strives to make sure such companies get all the recognition they deserve :)To Adam, Scott, Jason, and the rest of the Jet Solar teams, a HUGE thank you from my wife, and I, here in Melbourne, and we look forward to recommending you to anyone who needs the best service, and value, for solar home installation !
